summary.title: Flutter with Firebase Backend Project - Full Stack Tiktok Clone App | GetX
summary.one_liner: You learn how to build a TikTok-style video app in Flutter with Firebase authentication, storage and database, using GetX for state management, across a roughly 3h50m video.
keywords: how to build a short video app flutter
takeaways: Set up Flutter login and sign-up screens with email and password authentication backed by Firebase.
Upload videos with captions, compress them and generate thumbnails from the video.
Display a feed of videos, and add liking and commenting, including liking comments.
Implement user search, following, and profile screens showing followers, following, likes and posts.
Follow the project with GetX for state management and the source code linked in the video description.
summary.summary: This is a long video walkthrough by Rivaan Ranawat that builds a full-stack TikTok clone in Flutter. It is organized into chapters covering setup, login and sign-up UI, Firebase authentication and user model, persisting user state, a bottom tab bar, video upload with compression and thumbnails, a video feed, GetX controllers, likes and comments, search, and a profile screen. The features listed include email/password auth, captioned video upload, and following users. The source code is linked on GitHub in the description.
